- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24409-24439 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The source-PR-closed "not planned" close in _close_sweep_check_triage_gate does not hold while a clarify run is in flight. build_active_issue_set (lines 18727-18749) gets issue numbers only from head_branch patterns, and issue_comment-triggered clarify runs (/reclarify) report the default branch as head_branch. The phase-label hold also checks only ai:planning and ai:implementing, so the sweep can close the issue mid-run and the clarify run then posts questions on a closed issue.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree on severity: gemini, minimax, luna and glm rated it MAJOR and sonnet rated it NIT (narrow window, the source PR really was closed unmerged), so the highest (MAJOR → high) is used. Sonnet and minimax both warn against simply adding ai:clarification to the label hold, because that label stays on while questions wait for an answer (clarify.yml:1147, removed only at 1160/2187/1990) and would block the stuck issues this PR targets. Minimax suggests detecting in-flight clarify runs from the per-tick cached actions-runs payload (pattern at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22200-22215), with the issue title added to the existing gh issue list --json call.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23537-23541 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The new early-return log contract `CLOSE_MERGED_SWEEP issue=invalid triage_rule=skip reason=issue_num_invalid` has no test pinning it. Every sibling reason is asserted in test_close_merged_sweep_logs_check_triage_rule_skip_reasons (tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:19605).
  WHY: Rated NIT. Nothing breaks at runtime, but a later edit could restore the bare `[[ ... ]] || return 1` guard or rename the reason and still pass CI, reopening the silent-rejection gap issue #9481 targets. Sonnet and glm raised the same coverage gap as a hardening suggestion only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:_close_sweep_check_triage_gate phase-label hold ~24414-24420; build_active_issue_set 18727-18749 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The source-closed close does not hold while a clarify run is in flight. clarify.yml lines 1141-1147 add ai:clarification at run start, the runs report the default branch as head_branch, and ai:clarification is not a held label.
  WHY: A /reclarify run that overlaps a sweep tick lets the gate return pr_not_merged and close the issue as not planned; the clarify run then posts on a closed issue. The outcome is noise rather than a wrong close. Adding ai:clarification to the hold is the wrong fix: the label persists while answers are pending (clarify.yml:2027, removed at 1160/2187/1990), so the hold would keep those issues open indefinitely. A real fix would match in-flight clarify runs through the per-tick runs cache.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All deliverables verified present.
- HARDENING: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py: extract _close_sweep_check_triage_branch, call it with "1;x", and assert `CLOSE_MERGED_SWEEP issue=invalid triage_rule=skip reason=issue_num_invalid` and rc=1 (~6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  PROBLEM: The new aggressive close path (source PR closed unmerged → ai:closed, not planned) cannot see issue_comment-triggered clarify runs. They use the default branch as head_branch, and the phase-label hold covers only ai:planning/ai:implementing, while clarify.yml:1141-1145 sets ai:clarification. As a result, internal-clarify.yml:21-23 and clarify.yml:33-35 runs are not detected.
  WHY: The sweep closes the issue during a /reclarify run, and the is_closed route guard (clarify.yml:1017-1020) was already evaluated, so the questions are posted on a closed issue and the answer starts plan/implement against it. Do NOT add ai:clarification to the hold at 24417, because it is a steady-state label (clarify.yml:1147, removed at 1160/2187). Instead detect the in-flight run from the cached actions-runs payload, following the pattern at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22200-22215, and add `title` to the existing gh issue list --json call.
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All deliverables verified present. The pre-push gate's attribution of failures in unrelated tests to this diff does not hold.
